name: design-os-browser-extension
description: Capability-Tiered Agent RPC WebExtension Engine, LinkedIn Zero-Drift Hybrid Reader, SQLite local cache, CLI (`browser-agent`), and stdio MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the user's real Chromium or Firefox session for LinkedIn search, structured reads, local SQLite cache, and Copilot draft prefill.
interface.longDescription: Zero-drift hybrid DOM/passive-response WebExtension bridge wired to `browser-agent` CLI (`--json`) and 12 MCP tools over loopback WebSocket `127.0.0.1:4347` with fenced `(pageId, epoch, lease)` dispatch and strict Human Gate Handoff.
defaultPrompt: Check the active LinkedIn tab with linkedin_status, extract the profile via linkedin_get_profile, and store it cleanly.
Search LinkedIn people results with linkedin_search and query previously cached profiles with linkedin_query_cache.
Stage a reply draft via linkedin_draft_write with prefill enabled without ever clicking Send.
